definitions.explanation: To change position or location. Can describe physical movement of people, animals, vehicles, or objects. Also used for machines that are operating or functioning.

examples.japanese: この{時計|とけい}は{動|うご}いていません。
{電車|でんしゃ}が{動|うご}き{始|はじ}めました。

notes: This is an intransitive verb (the subject moves itself). The transitive counterpart is {動|うご}かす (to move something). Often used with ている to describe ongoing movement or a machine running.
